items.quote: send your API key as a bearer token in the Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> header.
items.why: Quote states bearer API key auth; says nothing on oauth2 or the full method list.

items.quote: Ahrefs Connect uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE).
items.why: Quote states the OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow only; api_key and bearer not covered.

items.quote: When your integration is ready, you'll need to submit it for verification before it can go live.
items.why: Quote concerns verification before go-live; says nothing about a paid plan gate.

items.quote: The remote MCP server is available on paid plans starting from Lite.
items.why: Paid-plan requirement stated, but only for the remote MCP server, not API credentials.

items.quote: Ahrefs API v3 gives programmatic access to Ahrefs' SEO, marketing, and AI-search data
items.why: Quote says broad SEO/marketing/AI-search data access; does not mention REST or base URL.

items.quote: The external MCP server is not a general-purpose programmatic API.
items.why: Quote implies an external MCP server exists; no URL and no vendor-official statement.
